title: Cav U Theorem
body_html:
Cav U Theorem

For a finite zero-sum repeated game with lack of information on one side, let $u(p)$ be the value of the nonrevealing one-shot game at prior $p$. The Aumann-Maschler theorem states that the values of the $T$-stage games converge to the concavification of $u$: $$ v_T(p)\to \operatorname{cav} u(p). $$

MFoGT also records the parallel discounted and uniform-value conclusions for this class of games.

References

  • [MFoGT, Chapter 8, Thm. 8.6.6] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MathFoundationsGameTheory.pdf. Aumann-Maschler cav u theorem for one-sided incomplete information.
